images.caption: Figure 1:Evidence-invariant predictions of the SFT policy. Predictions remain unchanged when the returned crop is replaced with a fixed placeholder. The pillow-bed association matches the scene in (a) but conflicts with it in (b), illustrating why answer correctness alone does not establish evidence use.

Figure 3:Overview of CARE-3D. At inference, the agent selects a grounding tool and reasons over its returned evidence. During post-training, GCS supplements free rollouts with underrepresented tools, while CARE computes Evidence Gain by contrasting ground truth answer likelihood under factual and evidence masked contexts. GRPO updates the agent using the resulting rewards.
Figure 4:Qualitative comparison on an attribute question. CARE-3D selects highlighted visual evidence and correctly recognizes the target object’s shape.
